title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: When you remove a feature from a model, think about how the model's complexity changes. A simpler model might fit the training data less closely. How does this affect the MSE on the training data?

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: Consider what happens to the model's ability to fit the training data when a feature is removed. Does the MSE on the training data increase, decrease, or can it do both?
